note: SYNTHETIC pattern fixture for the Overseer Trends section. Not a library case. Layer 1 does not read this file and did not choose the route.

vignette.pmh: severe COPD GOLD D, on home oxygen
vignette.meds: tiotropium inhaler daily; home oxygen 2 L nasal cannula
vignette.devices: home oxygen concentrator, fingertip oximeter, watch
vignette.goals: wants treatment at home, hospital if breathing does not recover at rest
vignette.function: walks indoors, desats when he stands or uses the commode, recovers at rest
vignette.discharge: pneumonia admission about 3 months ago, home after 4 days
vignette.trend: Day -6 to -1: resting SpO2 91-93% inside his band, resting HR 70-78. Eight SpO2 alerts on position change, each back in band at rest. Day 0 06:10 SpO2 84% rolling to sit up, back to 92% at rest. Day 0 09:40 SpO2 85% walking to the commode, back to 91% at rest.
vignette.note: He is on 2 L nasal cannula. Desats with position change are usual for him. No increase in sputum. Resting SpO2 is still in his band.

layer1.plain_reason: Positional desats match this patient's known pattern. The preference for this pattern is log only, not a page.
layer1.route_definition: Log only. No page and no handoff.

pattern.trigger: Today’s SpO2 84% (sit up) / 85% (commode), recovered to band.
pattern.headline: 8 similar SpO2 alerts this week · often on position change · resting SpO2 usually in band
pattern.summary: These alerts are the same positional desats he already has. Resting SpO2 stays inside the band set for him. A new page is not what this pattern asks for.
pattern.rule_note: After repeated similar alerts, the preference for positional desat on this patient was adjusted to log only. A page is not the default for this pattern.
pattern.horizon: About 3 months ago, exertion-related alerts rose for two weeks while resting SpO2 stayed in band. That run came before a pneumonia admission. Today's alerts are positional, not that exertional rise.

alerts.action: Logged. Same positional pattern. No page.
Logged. Resting readings stayed in band.
Positional desat preference set to log only after the same cluster.

vitals.name: SpO2
vitals.outside_note: Two readings outside the band: 84% rolling over, 85% at the commode. Both returned to band at rest.

vitals.name: HR
vitals.outside_note: Heart rate leaves the band only with the same position changes, then settles.

mind.confidence: Pattern favored. Not a closed diagnosis.
mind.flip_if: resting SpO2 stays below the band
mind.goals_line: Hospital is acceptable if rest does not recover.

vignette.goals: wants hospital care if breathing does not recover at rest
vignette.function: walks indoors, usual desat on standing, recovers at rest
vignette.trend: Yesterday the same positional dips were logged only. Today resting SpO2 is 86% for 20 minutes and has not returned to band.
vignette.note: Spouse reports more sputum this morning. The positional log from yesterday no longer matches a resting reading.

layer1.plain_reason: Resting oxygen is below band after a log-only positional pattern.
layer1.route_definition: Nurse contact. The prior log is no longer the whole story.

pattern.trigger: Resting SpO2 86% for 20 minutes. Not back in band.
pattern.headline: Yesterday: log only for positional dips. Today the resting reading left the band.
pattern.summary: The prior log-only decision was for dips that recovered at rest. This resting reading does not recover.
pattern.rule_note: Revise the prior log. The new resting reading is the evidence that changes it.
pattern.horizon: One prior Pass or Log only is on this card so the correction can be logged.

alerts.what: Positional SpO2 dips, recovered at rest

alerts.action: Prior log no longer fits. Revise.

vitals.name: SpO2
vitals.outside_note: The last three readings are resting and outside the band.

mind.confidence: Prior log is falsified. The cause is not closed.
mind.act_banner: Act under uncertainty. Revise the route before naming one cause.
mind.new_evidence: Resting SpO2 86% for 20 minutes, sputum up
mind.wait_for: a repeat resting SpO2 after the nurse is with her
mind.flip_if: resting SpO2 is still below 88% with the nurse present
mind.goals_line: Hospital is acceptable if rest does not recover.

vignette.trend: Day 0 watch SpO2 70% with a poor waveform. No fingertip repeat. One note says unresponsive. A second note, same hour, says he is talking and looks pink.
vignette.note: The two notes disagree and the only oxygen number has a poor waveform. The proposing agent refuses to pick a route.

layer1.plain_reason: Conflicting notes and an incomplete oxygen trace. No route is owned.
layer1.route_definition: Shown only so a human can replace it. The agent does not pass this.

pattern.trigger: SpO2 70% poor waveform, and two notes that disagree.
pattern.headline: Incomplete trace. One note says unresponsive. The other says talking and pink.
pattern.summary: The agent does not close this. A human chooses Log only, Pass, or a role verb.
pattern.rule_note: Refusal is logged. Nothing on this card auto-passes.
pattern.horizon: A later resting waveform, or a person in the room, is what would let someone else decide.

vitals.name: SpO2
vitals.band: Usual night minimum 94. This trace is not a resting band.
vitals.outside_note: 70% is a poor waveform. It is not a confirmed resting reading.

mind.confidence: The agent will not choose. The list stays open.
mind.act_banner: Act under uncertainty only after you choose. The agent refused to pass this.
mind.wait_for: a person in the room and a fingertip waveform
mind.flip_if: he is hard to rouse or the fingertip stays under 88%
mind.refusal_reason: The proposing agent refused. Notes conflict and the oxygen trace is incomplete. You choose Log only, Pass, or a role action. This card does not auto-pass.
mind.goals_line: Goals of care are not recorded.

vignette.goals: do-not-hospitalize, comfort-focused, would refuse ambulance and hospital
vignette.trend: Day 0 temperature 38.4 C and new confusion beyond her baseline. SpO2 92% at rest.
vignette.note: Daughter is present. The written goals refuse hospital and ambulance. Comfort at home is the plan.

layer1.plain_reason: Fever and new confusion. The page is constrained by do-not-hospitalize goals.
layer1.route_definition: A page is on the card so the goals constraint is visible. It is not an aligned default.

pattern.trigger: Temperature 38.4 C and confusion beyond baseline.
pattern.headline: Do-not-hospitalize. Comfort at home. Family is present.
pattern.summary: The urgent-page chip is what a symptom rule would send. The goals line constrains that page.
pattern.rule_note: A page that leads to hospital fights the stated refusal. The aligned action is a comfort check at home.
pattern.horizon: Goals were written before this fever. They still constrain tonight's pass.

vitals.name: SpO2
vitals.outside_note: Oxygen is near baseline. The constraint is the goals, not this number.

mind.confidence: Cause open. Goals already constrain the page.
mind.act_banner: Act under uncertainty inside the goals. Comfort at home comes before a hospital label.
mind.flip_if: distress they would want treated at home
mind.goals_line: Would refuse hospital and ambulance. Do-not-hospitalize, comfort-focused.

vignette.goals: wants hospital care if needed, prefers to stay at home
vignette.trend: Day 0 cough for one day. Temperature 37.6 C. Resting SpO2 96%, inside band. No exam recorded.
vignette.note: Spouse says he is drinking and talking. No chest pain. The missing piece is whether the temperature or the oxygen moves.

layer1.plain_reason: Hold for a temperature and a resting oxygen. Name what would change the route.
layer1.route_definition: Log only unless the waited observation flips the route.

pattern.trigger: Cough one day, temperature 37.6 C, resting SpO2 still 96%.
pattern.headline: Incomplete exam. Oxygen is in band. The useful next fact is named.
pattern.summary: Wait is the action. The observation and the route it would flip are on the button.
pattern.rule_note: A wait logs the expected information and the route that would replace this one. It does not page.
pattern.horizon: Six hours of temperature and resting SpO2 is the window on this fixture.

vitals.name: SpO2
vitals.outside_note: Every reading is inside the band.

mind.confidence: Low concern while oxygen holds. The list is not closed.
mind.wait_for: temperature and resting SpO2 over 6 hours
mind.flip_if: temperature reaches 38.5 C or resting SpO2 leaves the band
mind.goals_line: Hospital is acceptable if home treatment does not recover.
